title: Setup Prompt 0 · Idea Feasibility Gate
description: 把初步研究想法发展为可核验的 proposal，并作出是否立项的明确裁决。

title: Setup Prompt 1 · Workspace Bootstrap
description: 建立统一目录、Claude 工作规则与跨 session 的项目状态入口。

title: Setup Prompt 2 · Environment Bootstrap
description: 验证实证与写作环境并记录长期配置。

title: Setup Prompt 3 · Durable Project Map Refresh
description: 让 PROJECT.md 始终保持为精简、准确且可跨 session 使用的项目地图。

title: Setup Prompt 4 · Session Handoff Refresh
description: 在上下文压缩或重要节点结束前完成必要收尾，并为下一个 Claude session 留下精简交接。

title: Acquisition Prompt 1 · Chinese Government Web Harvesting Playbook
description: 为中文政府网站数据采集建立可审计、可恢复、可跨 session 延续的完整工作规范。

title: Notes Prompt 0A · Initial Empirical Design Map
description: 大规模探索前，从本地材料建立数据、设定、识别与实施决策地图。

title: Notes Prompt 0B · Empirical Design Map Update
description: 根据最新数据、代码与输出刷新设计地图，只保留当前有效判断。

title: Notes Prompt 0C · Implement GPT Pro Review
description: 以本地事实核验 Pro 意见，完成高价值检查并更新权威证据。

title: Notes Prompt 0D · GPT Pro Re-adjudication
description: 依据新核查证据重新裁决识别、设定与解释是否已经站得住。

title: Notes Prompt 1 · Single-Prompt Exploration
description: 围绕具体研究问题扩展可复用证据层。

title: 0. 总控
description: 限定证据层目标、保存范围与基本纪律。

title: H1. 横向：Research-space expansion
description: 横向发现具有实质价值的新研究分支。

title: H2. 横向：Empirical-space expansion
description: 围绕明确问题扩展可辩护的实证选择。

title: V1. 纵向：Deep investigation
description: 深挖关键分支并裁定其证据状态。

title: V2. 纵向：Adversarial audit
description: 以真实失效机制对核心发现进行压力测试。

title: H3. 再横向：Evidence-conditioned discovery
description: 从既有异常与矛盾中发现新研究方向。

title: C1. 收敛：Branch adjudication
description: 汇总证据、裁决分支并安排后续资源。

title: X1. 按需：Contradiction resolution
description: 解释冲突证据并设计可区分的新检验。

title: 循环
description: 规定探索循环、插入条件与停止标准。

title: Routing Prompt 0 · Literature Triage
description: 先给文献分配阅读预算，只保留可能改变最终 Brief 的高价值论文。

title: Routing Prompt 1 · Close Reading
description: 逐篇精读真正重要的论文，并把 binding implications 落盘。

title: Routing Prompt 1A · Ex Ante Hypothesis & Outcome Audit
description: 先固定事前 hypothesis hierarchy 与对应 measurement，再以同一标准裁决现有 evidence 和下一步。

title: Routing Prompt 2 · Literature Synthesis → Brief Input Pack
description: 把完整 evidence、design 与 closest literature 压缩成供 Pro 裁决的输入包。

title: Routing Prompt 3 · Evidence / Brief Router
description: 核心裁决器：决定哪些问题已足够、哪些值得回到 evidence、哪些应收窄或停止。

title: Routing Prompt 4A · Existing Data → Targeted Notes
description: 只用现有数据解决会改变 Brief 的少数 uncertainty，不重开全部 specification space。

title: Routing Prompt 4B · New Data → Feasibility
description: 新增数据前先做 value-of-information 与现实可行性判断。

title: Routing Prompt 4C · New Data → Acquisition / Integration
description: 按已裁决的最小方案获取并接入数据，再回到 Notes 回答原始问题。

title: Routing Prompt 5 · Evidence Return → Pro
description: 把本轮针对性证据压缩成可重新交给 Router 的裁决材料。

title: Routing Prompt 6 · Candidate Brief
description: 在 paper-level evidence 足够后，比较 competing identities 并设计最强可辩护论文。

title: Routing Prompt 7 · Reverse Audit of Candidate Brief
description: 用完整本地 evidence 与 literature 反查 Pro 压缩世界中的遗漏、误读与过度 claim。

title: Routing Prompt 8 · Final Brief Lock
description: 解决候选 Brief 与本地反审计的冲突，锁定最终 authoritative research brief。

title: Routing Prompt 9 · Materialize Final Brief
description: 把最终裁决落到唯一 current Brief，并同步项目阶段与跨 session 状态。

title: Brief Prompt 1 · Paper Ceiling
description: 从证据反推最强论文身份与合理发表上限。

title: Brief Prompt 2 · Journal Mapping
description: 核实期刊信息并设计风险收益最优的投稿路径。

title: Brief Prompt 3 · Journal Requirements
description: 提炼并保存目标期刊的官方投稿约束。

title: Brief Prompt 4 · Literature Map
description: 分级核实核心文献并识别定位与新颖性风险。

title: Brief Prompt 5 · Lock Manuscript Brief
description: 锁定面向目标期刊的论文主线、主张边界与证据结构。

title: Build Manuscript
description: 将已锁定的 Brief 转化为唯一可编译论文工程。

title: General instruction — optional
description: 可按需附在具体审阅 Prompt 前；无需每次单独运行。

title: Q1A · Figure / Table
description: 全面优化单个图表的正确性、排版与可读性。

title: Q1B · Interpretable Magnitudes
description: 选择读者可直接解释、且不改变 estimand 的主文结果尺度。

title: Q2 · Headings
description: 优化正文与附录标题的准确性和叙事性。

title: Q3 · Formatting
description: 排查粗体、斜体与段首格式的滥用。

title: Q4 · Introduction
description: 按经典投稿规范审核引言结构、钩子与贡献。

title: Q5 · Discussion
description: 控制讨论范围并妥善回应外推与潜在缺陷。

title: Q6 · Exhibit Order
description: 重排正文与附录图表以改善叙事流和归属。

title: Paper Identity
description: 锁定论文身份、核心贡献与唯一中心信息。

title: Claim Hierarchy
description: 按证据强度重排全文主张及叙事权重。

title: Abstract
description: 按目标期刊标准诊断摘要的信息结构。

title: Background / Institutional Context
description: 判断制度背景是否为研究问题与识别提供了足够、准确且克制的支撑。

title: Data & Measures
description: 审核样本、时点、变量测量与呈现可信度。

title: Analytic Strategy / Identification
description: 明确识别变异、估计对象与因果主张边界。

title: Identification Assumptions & Evidence Audit
description: 把核心识别假设映射到经济学家会期待的检验、诊断与支持证据。

title: Empirical Specification Audit
description: 检查实证设定是否准确承载 identification、estimand 与系数解释。

title: Results Narrative
description: 以研究问题为主线重组结果章节叙事。

title: Heterogeneity & Mechanisms
description: 区分异质性、机制与探索性证据的价值。

title: Economic Mechanism Interpretation Audit
description: 从整体证据反推可辩护的经济机制，并界定可观察环节与替代解释。

title: Conclusion
description: 检查结论是否准确收束发现、边界与意义。

title: Estimand Audit
description: 核对各结果的估计对象、可比性与主张匹配。

title: Estimand Type & Compliance Audit
description: 判定研究真正识别的 estimand，并核对处理定义、依从性与系数解释。

title: Null Results
description: 校准空结果的统计表述、精度与经济含义。

title: Robustness Architecture
description: 让每项稳健性检验对应一个明确威胁。

title: Literature Positioning
description: 核实最近文献并建立可辩护的贡献定位。

title: Single-Paper Deep Review
description: 深读单篇文献并判断其对本项目的意义。

title: Citation Audit
description: 核查引文支持、完整性与参考文献一致性。

title: Incremental Literature Discovery & Reading Triage
description: 向现有文献边界外扩展，并按阅读、下载和新颖性风险筛选增量文献。

title: Standalone Table / Figure Audit
description: 检验图表脱离正文后能否被准确理解。

title: Footnote Audit
description: 判定脚注去留、位置及其对正文的影响。

title: Appendix as Evidence Architecture
description: 按功能重建附录的支持性证据架构。

title: Full-Manuscript Consistency Audit
description: 查找正文、图表与附录中的内部不一致。

title: Key Number Cross-Check
description: 以权威结果为准，对账 manuscript 与投稿材料中重复出现的关键数字。

title: Precision & Rounding Audit
description: 统一全文和投稿材料的数字精度规则，并排查 rounding 导致的表观矛盾。

title: Numbering & Reference Order Audit
description: 核对全文结构、图表、公式和附录编号及其引用顺序。

title: Terminology & Notation Audit
description: 统一术语、缩写和数学符号的定义与使用。

title: Caveats, Limitations & Defensive Writing Audit
description: 按科学重要性裁决全文 caveats、limitations 与 defensive writing 的取舍和位置。

title: Review Comment Adjudication
description: 识别外部审阅意见背后的真实 concern，并选择副作用最小的有效回应。

title: Revision Ripple-Effect Audit
description: 核验修改要求并追踪改动的连锁影响。

title: Revision Residue Audit
description: 清除多轮讨论、纠错和旧方案在最终成品中的无价值残留。

title: Five-Minute Editor Read
description: 模拟编辑快速初筛并识别桌拒风险。

title: Hostile Referee Simulation
description: 模拟严苛审稿人寻找最强拒稿理由。

title: Friendly Senior Coauthor
description: 在少增新工作的前提下寻找论文提档机会。

title: What Am I Not Seeing?
description: 跳出清单识别作者最可能忽视的关键问题。

title: Compression Pass
description: 在不损失实质内容下压缩论文篇幅。

title: Paragraph-Level Narrative Audit
description: 按段诊断任务、主题句、衔接与删改价值。

title: Prose Quality & Readability Audit
description: 审核全文是否具备成熟 applied economics manuscript 的自然、清晰与专业表达。

title: Pre-Submission Robustness Adjudication
description: 投稿前裁决必补、可选与应停止的检验。

title: Manuscript Integration Audit
description: 验收多轮修改后的逻辑闭环与全文统一性。

title: Technical Artifact Audit
description: 只检查 LaTeX、最终 PDF 与正式文档中的技术和呈现缺陷。

title: Final Manuscript Audit
description: 对今天即将上传的最终 manuscript PDF 做技术、合规与一致性验收。

title: Actual Submission Package
description: 组装并交叉核验今天实际上传的投稿文件与系统元数据。

title: Clean-Room Replication Package
description: 构建与定稿论文严格匹配的可复现交付包。

title: Frozen Project Snapshot
description: 冻结足以完整重启项目的重要节点快照。

title: Setup Prompt 0 · Idea Feasibility Gate
description: Develop a preliminary research idea into a verifiable proposal and make a clear go / wait / stop decision.

title: Setup Prompt 1 · Workspace Bootstrap
description: Create the standard directory structure, Claude operating rules, and cross-session project-state entry points.

title: Setup Prompt 2 · Environment Bootstrap
description: Verify the empirical and writing environments and preserve the durable configuration.

title: Setup Prompt 3 · Durable Project Map Refresh
description: Keep PROJECT.md concise, accurate, and useful across sessions.

title: Setup Prompt 4 · Session Handoff Refresh
description: Complete context-dependent closing work before compression or a major stopping point, then leave a concise handoff for the next Claude session.

title: Acquisition Prompt 1 · Chinese Government Web Harvesting Playbook
description: Establish an auditable, restartable, and cross-session operating standard for harvesting data from Chinese government websites.

title: Notes Prompt 0A · Initial Empirical Design Map
description: Before large-scale exploration, build a local map of the data, specification space, identification possibilities, and implementation decisions.

title: Notes Prompt 0B · Empirical Design Map Update
description: Refresh the design map from the current data, code, documentation, and outputs, retaining only judgments that remain valid.

title: Notes Prompt 0C · Implement GPT Pro Review
description: Check Pro’s review against local facts, carry out high-value diagnostics, and update the authoritative evidence.

title: Notes Prompt 0D · GPT Pro Re-adjudication
description: Re-adjudicate whether the identification, specification, and interpretation are defensible in light of the newly verified evidence.

title: Notes Prompt 1 · Single-Prompt Exploration
description: Expand a reusable evidence layer around a specific research question.

title: 0. Control
description: Define the objective, preservation scope, and basic discipline of the evidence layer.

title: H1. Horizontal: Research-Space Expansion
description: Identify substantively valuable new research branches.

title: H2. Horizontal: Empirical-Space Expansion
description: Expand defensible empirical choices around clearly defined questions.

title: V1. Vertical: Deep Investigation
description: Investigate a key branch deeply enough to adjudicate its evidence status.

title: V2. Vertical: Adversarial Audit
description: Stress-test the core finding against plausible ways it could fail.

title: H3. Horizontal Again: Evidence-Conditioned Discovery
description: Use existing anomalies and contradictions to discover new research directions.

title: C1. Convergence: Branch Adjudication
description: Synthesize the evidence, adjudicate branches, and allocate the next round of effort.

title: X1. As Needed: Contradiction Resolution
description: Explain conflicting evidence and design evidence capable of distinguishing competing accounts.

title: Cycle
description: Specify the exploration cycle, when to insert contradiction resolution, and when to stop.

title: Routing Prompt 0 · Literature Triage
description: Allocate the reading budget before close reading, retaining only papers that could change the final Brief.

title: Routing Prompt 1 · Close Reading
description: Closely read the genuinely important papers and preserve their binding implications in project artifacts.

title: Routing Prompt 1A · Ex Ante Hypothesis & Outcome Audit
description: Fix the ex ante hypothesis hierarchy and corresponding measurements before adjudicating the current evidence and next step against that standard.

title: Routing Prompt 2 · Literature Synthesis → Brief Input Pack
description: Compress the evidence, design, and closest literature into an input pack for Pro adjudication.

title: Routing Prompt 3 · Evidence / Brief Router
description: The central adjudicator: decide what is already sufficient, what justifies reopening evidence, and what should instead be narrowed or stopped.

title: Routing Prompt 4A · Existing Data → Targeted Notes
description: Use existing data only to resolve the small number of uncertainties that could change the Brief; do not reopen the entire specification space.

title: Routing Prompt 4B · New Data → Feasibility
description: Before acquiring new data, assess value of information and practical feasibility.

title: Routing Prompt 4C · New Data → Acquisition / Integration
description: Acquire and integrate only the data in the adjudicated minimum plan, then return to Notes to answer the original question.

title: Routing Prompt 5 · Evidence Return → Pro
description: Compress the targeted evidence work into material that can be returned to the Router for re-adjudication.

title: Routing Prompt 6 · Candidate Brief
description: Once paper-level evidence is sufficient, compare competing identities and design the strongest defensible paper.

title: Routing Prompt 7 · Reverse Audit of Candidate Brief
description: Check Pro’s compressed world against the full local evidence and literature for omissions, misreadings, and overclaims.

title: Routing Prompt 8 · Final Brief Lock
description: Resolve conflicts between the Candidate Brief and the local reverse audit, then lock the authoritative research brief.

title: Routing Prompt 9 · Materialize Final Brief
description: Write the final adjudication into the single current Brief and synchronize the project stage and cross-session state.

title: Brief Prompt 1 · Paper Ceiling
description: Work backward from the evidence to identify the strongest paper identity and a realistic publication ceiling.

title: Brief Prompt 2 · Journal Mapping
description: Verify current journal information and design the submission path with the best risk–return profile.

title: Brief Prompt 3 · Journal Requirements
description: Extract and preserve the target journal’s official submission requirements.

title: Brief Prompt 4 · Literature Map
description: Verify and prioritize the core literature, while identifying positioning and novelty risks.

title: Brief Prompt 5 · Lock Manuscript Brief
description: Lock the paper’s journal-specific central argument, claim boundary, and evidence architecture.

title: Build Manuscript
description: Turn the locked Brief into the single authoritative, compilable manuscript project.

title: General Instruction — Optional
description: May be prefixed to a specific review prompt when useful; it need not be run separately each time.

title: Q1A · Figure / Table
description: Review and improve a single figure or table for correctness, layout, and readability.

title: Q1B · Interpretable Magnitudes
description: Present main-text results on a scale readers can interpret directly without changing the estimand.

title: Q2 · Headings
description: Improve the accuracy, clarity, and narrative function of headings in the manuscript and appendix.

title: Q3 · Formatting
description: Identify overuse of bold, italics, and special formatting at paragraph openings.

title: Q4 · Introduction
description: Review the Introduction against classic submission standards for structure, hook, and contribution.

title: Q5 · Discussion
description: Control the scope of the Discussion and respond appropriately to external-validity and limitation concerns.

title: Q6 · Exhibit Order
description: Reorder main-text and appendix exhibits to improve narrative flow and placement.

title: Paper Identity
description: Identify the paper’s core identity, contribution, and single central message.

title: Claim Hierarchy
description: Reorder the manuscript’s claims and narrative weight according to the strength of the evidence.

title: Abstract
description: Diagnose the Abstract’s information structure using the target journal’s reading conventions.

title: Background / Institutional Context
description: Assess whether the institutional background supports the research question and identification accurately, sufficiently, and without excess.

title: Data & Measures
description: Review the sample, timing, measurement, and credibility of data presentation.

title: Analytic Strategy / Identification
description: Clarify the identifying variation, estimand, and boundary of causal claims.

title: Identification Assumptions & Evidence Audit
description: Map the central identifying assumptions to the tests, diagnostics, and supporting evidence an economist would normally expect.

title: Empirical Specification Audit
description: Check whether the empirical specification accurately carries the identification, estimand, and coefficient interpretation.

title: Results Narrative
description: Reorganize the Results around substantive questions rather than regression output.

title: Heterogeneity & Mechanisms
description: Distinguish useful heterogeneity and mechanism evidence from descriptive or exploratory subgroup results.

title: Economic Mechanism Interpretation Audit
description: Infer a defensible economic mechanism from the overall evidence while distinguishing observed links from untestable steps and alternative explanations.

title: Conclusion
description: Check whether the Conclusion closes the paper accurately around the findings, boundaries, and significance.

title: Estimand Audit
description: Check what each result estimates, whether the results are comparable, and whether each estimand matches the corresponding claim.

title: Estimand Type & Compliance Audit
description: Identify the estimand the study actually recovers and align treatment, compliance, sample, and coefficient interpretation with it.

title: Null Results
description: Calibrate the statistical language, precision, and economic meaning of null or imprecise results.

title: Robustness Architecture
description: Require each robustness exercise to answer a specific threat rather than accumulating specifications.

title: Literature Positioning
description: Verify the closest literature and build a defensible intellectual position for the paper.

title: Single-Paper Deep Review
description: Read one paper deeply and determine exactly what it means for this project.

title: Citation Audit
description: Check whether citations truly support the text and whether in-text citations and references are complete and consistent.

title: Incremental Literature Discovery & Reading Triage
description: Search beyond the current literature boundary and triage additional papers by reading value, download value, and novelty risk.

title: Standalone Table / Figure Audit
description: Test whether a table or figure can be interpreted accurately without relying on the main text.

title: Footnote Audit
description: Determine whether each footnote should remain, move, or be deleted, and whether the surrounding main text remains accurate without it.

title: Appendix as Evidence Architecture
description: Rebuild the appendix as a functional supporting-evidence architecture rather than a repository of overflow material.

title: Full-Manuscript Consistency Audit
description: Identify internal inconsistencies across the main text, exhibits, notes, and appendix.

title: Key Number Cross-Check
description: Reconcile repeated key numbers across the manuscript and submission materials against the authoritative results.

title: Precision & Rounding Audit
description: Establish a stable precision convention across the manuscript and submission materials and identify apparent contradictions created by rounding.

title: Numbering & Reference Order Audit
description: Check the numbering and citation order of sections, equations, exhibits, and appendices.

title: Terminology & Notation Audit
description: Unify definitions and usage of terms, abbreviations, and mathematical notation.

title: Caveats, Limitations & Defensive Writing Audit
description: Adjudicate whether caveats and limitations belong in the paper, how prominently they should appear, and where they should be placed.

title: Review Comment Adjudication
description: Identify the real concern behind external review comments and choose an effective response with minimal collateral damage.

title: Revision Ripple-Effect Audit
description: Verify that requested revisions were completed and trace any new problems created by the changes.

title: Revision Residue Audit
description: Remove obsolete traces of prior discussion, correction, and rejected alternatives from the final artifact.

title: Five-Minute Editor Read
description: Simulate an editor’s rapid initial screen and identify the most likely desk-rejection risk.

title: Hostile Referee Simulation
description: Simulate a demanding referee and identify the strongest defensible reasons for rejection.

title: Friendly Senior Coauthor
description: Look for ways to raise the paper’s level without creating a large amount of new work.

title: What Am I Not Seeing?
description: Step outside fixed checklists and identify the most important issue the author is likely overlooking.

title: Compression Pass
description: Shorten the paper without losing substantive content.

title: Paragraph-Level Narrative Audit
description: Diagnose the function, topic sentence, transitions, and deletion value of each paragraph.

title: Prose Quality & Readability Audit
description: Assess whether the prose is natural, clear, and professional at the level of a mature applied economics manuscript.

title: Pre-Submission Robustness Adjudication
description: Before submission, distinguish required, optional, and no-longer-worthwhile robustness work.

title: Manuscript Integration Audit
description: Test whether many local revisions have converged into one coherent and closed manuscript-level argument.

title: Technical Artifact Audit
description: Review only technical and presentation defects in the LaTeX project, final PDF, and formal documentation.

title: Final Manuscript Audit
description: Conduct the final technical, compliance, and consistency review of the manuscript PDF that is about to be uploaded.

title: Actual Submission Package
description: Assemble and cross-check the exact files and system metadata that will be uploaded today.

title: Clean-Room Replication Package
description: Build a third-party replication package that matches the final paper exactly.

title: Frozen Project Snapshot
description: Freeze a minimal but sufficient milestone snapshot from which the project can be restarted fully.
